evidence_type: source-code/provenance semantic audit; no new biological outcome read

graph_construct.input: island centroid latitude/longitude, geodesic haversine distance and bioregion grouping
graph_construct.graph: undirected symmetrized k-nearest-neighbor graph, with the minimum k producing a connected component within each bioregion
graph_construct.regional_optimization: choose smallest k in 1..n-1 that connects a region; no biological response or observed movement

null_construct.scope: one response-independent constructed geographic graph compared to matched rewired graph surrogates

interpretation.valid_heldout_result: for the 529-species ultrarare layer, graph-derived source features improve realized-presence prediction beyond an already source-aware Euclidean R3; within the preregistered rewiring null family the original geography-derived graph outperformed all 20 surrogates
interpretation.invalid_inference: the actual ecological/dispersal adjacency is identified, or source-island stepping-stone corridors are demonstrated
interpretation.still_unresolved: whether geography-derived graph advantage represents ecological permeability, geometric coherence beyond the matched null's constraints, habitat/environmental spatial autocorrelation, or other unmeasured processes
interpretation.relationship_to_v181: the posthoc source-identity turnover test is adverse to source-territory irreplaceability; it cannot rescue biological graph interpretation
interpretation.temporal_boundary: the BALA independent source-loss primary was not supportive
interpretation.manuscript_ceiling: coordinate-derived predictive graph architecture; no observed animal paths, colonization or rescue
interpretation.article_novelty_warning: a matched rewiring advantage alone does not establish a previously unknown biological dispersal mechanism

next_scientific_step: explicitly distinguish geometric graph-information result from ecological dispersal mechanism, and seek only genuinely independent response-free ecological movement, dispersal or temporal colonization validation
